# Module index

| # | Module | Time | What you learn |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 00 | [Setup & orientation](../modules/00-setup/README.md) | 4 min | Confirm your connection and see why TigerData is "just PostgreSQL". |
| 01 | [Hypertables & chunks](../modules/01-hypertables/README.md) | 8 min | Create a hypertable, watch chunks appear, and see the planner skip the ones it does not need. |
| 02 | [Write & query time-series data](../modules/02-write-and-query/README.md) | 9 min | Bulk-load rows, bucket them into intervals, and join a hypertable with ordinary metadata. |
| 03 | [Continuous aggregates](../modules/03-continuous-aggregates/README.md) | 10 min | Pre-compute rollups that refresh incrementally, and measure the speedup yourself. |
| 04 | [Hypercore: the columnstore](../modules/04-columnstore/README.md) | 10 min | Convert older chunks to columnar storage and measure the real size and speed difference. |
| 05 | [Jobs, policies & retention](../modules/05-jobs-and-policies/README.md) | 9 min | Every policy is a background job. Inspect them, run them on demand, and write your own. |
| 06 | [Hyperfunctions for analytics](../modules/06-hyperfunctions/README.md) | 11 min | Fill gaps, measure counters and rates, and compute percentiles without dragging raw rows around. |
| 07 | [Performance optimization](../modules/07-performance/README.md) | 10 min | Index for your real access pattern, size chunks sensibly, and read plans with confidence. |
| 08 | [Capstone: a complete pipeline](../modules/08-capstone/README.md) | 12 min | Assemble everything into one production-shaped pipeline: ingest, rollup, compress, retain, query. |
